Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in to occur after selecting or creating a pet, allowing users to experience the fun part before creating an account. (why: High drop-off at adoption (60.9%) and sign-in early on slows momentum. Delaying account creation until after pet choice builds intent.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Add Custom Pet Preview Stage: Insert a new pet preview screen immediately following creation/selection so users confirm graphics before final adoption. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Spawn Live Status: Display explicit status progress and setup instructions during the waiting screen to reassure users while rendering graphics. (why: The waiting phase has high mean duration (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets not rendering on the desktop.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Streamline Path Selection Headlines: Simplify choose_path copy to highlight quick preset choices versus creating custom pets from scratch. (why: Choose path drop-off is 76.2% with a mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion between paths.)
4: [finish, redesign] Redesign Home Intro with Desktop Video Demo: Redesign home_intro with a split layout featuring a quick video demo showing how the desktop pet behaves on screen. (why: Multiple support emails cite post-onboarding confusion regarding how to interact with desktop pets.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Introductory Story Welcome Screen: Add an engaging intro screen explaining the desktop pet concept before asking users to select a path. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8% and early drop-off occurs at choose_path (76.2%).)
